{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:38.059
    | text      = So today we're going to be talking about January 4th.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:41.419
    | text      = This is Alex's Sunday show after Trump has taken Maduro.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:46.820
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:47.820
    | text      = And obviously it's time that we rationalize this and we live in the world post regime
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:55.580
    | text      = change.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:56.580
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:57.580
    | text      = And so Alex starts off the show with that being his main focus.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.179
    | text      = That's why when Hegseth came out and the reporters like this is like Iraq regime change,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:07.220
    | text      = he says it's the opposite.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:09.220
    | text      = Because the previous regime change was about destabilizing the Middle East and balkanizing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:17.539
    | text      = it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:18.539
    | text      = The United States wants to go in and have free and fair elections and turn Venezuela
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:22.639
    | text      = of its own power back into the most wealthy country in Latin America.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:29.700
    | text      = But you have to know the history.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:30.820
    | text      = You have to know the Monroe Doctrine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:32.259
    | text      = You have to know what gunboat diplomacy is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:34.500
    | text      = You have to know the Barbary policy of Thomas Jefferson.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:39.200
    | text      = You have to understand all of that to understand this is a no brainer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:46.220
    | text      = So one thing that anyone listening to Alex's show could not help but notice is that in
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:50.500
    | text      = the past six months or so, he's been constantly making references to Thomas Jefferson and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:55.179
    | text      = his Barbary Coast precedent.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:57.659
    | text      = This is a reference to the Barbary Wars of the early 1800s where Jefferson sent Marines
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:01.960
    | text      = to fight against pirates in the waters near Tripoli.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:05.200
    | text      = The idea is supposed to be that these pirates posed a national security threat so Jefferson
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:09.500
    | text      = was within his right to attack and kill them at sea, which is then used as an argument
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:14.059
    | text      = that Trump has the right to do this with the Venezuelan boats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.899
    | text      = It was part of the justification of Trump's militaristic action.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:21.980
    | text      = This idea is combined with references to the Monroe Doctrine, which is a bit convoluted.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:27.860
    | text      = The Monroe Doctrine essentially says that the US has control over everything in the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:31.460
    | text      = Western Hemisphere, so any hostile powers trying to take over countries on our half
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:35.779
    | text      = of the world can be seen as enemies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:38.399
    | text      = This has nothing to do with Jefferson's actions during the Barbary Wars because that was centered
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:42.360
    | text      = around North African states which are in the Eastern Hemisphere.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:46.259
    | text      = The point I'm making here is that Thomas Jefferson Barbary War stuff is a talking point, and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:51.419
    | text      = I'm pretty convinced that he's been told to push this by someone else.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:56.340
    | text      = It's not a point that he ever brought up before 2020, and even then it was in the context
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:00.980
    | text      = of an interview with a historian talking about Jefferson's actions in the Barbary Wars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:06.220
    | text      = It was not to defend sinking boats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:09.460
    | text      = It was a fun fact back then, and now this is a piece of information.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:13.480
    | text      = And precedent and shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:15.340
    | text      = Typically when the Barbary Wars were mentioned on Infowars, it was because someone was trying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:19.480
    | text      = to insist that white people weren't the only ones who ever engaged in slave trafficking.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:24.399
    | text      = That context changed on September 4th, 2025, after which point Alex began consistently
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:30.200
    | text      = repeating this new talking point about Jefferson's actions in the Barbary War as a justification
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:35.360
    | text      = for Trump sinking Venezuelan boats.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:38.440
    | text      = What I'm getting at here is I don't believe this is organic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:41.899
    | text      = If Alex truly felt like Jefferson's attack on the Barbary pirates justified whatever
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:45.919
    | text      = military actions a president could argue were meant to protect the American people,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.360
    | text      = then it would have come up in conversations about things like the invasion of Grenada
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:55.039
    | text      = or Clinton's planned attack on Haiti.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:57.639
    | text      = Probably.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:58.639
    | text      = I would bet that someone like Roger Stone or General Flynn advised Alex to start justifying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:02.639
    | text      = the boat attacks using this language because the increase is just too much to be a coincidence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:08.000
    | text      = And he didn't come up with this on his own.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:10.419
    | text      = The same thing is happening now more recently with the term gunboat diplomacy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:15.720
    | text      = Alex is starting to use that expression more as a way to justify Trump's belligerent actions
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:19.840
    | text      = against other countries.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.320
    | text      = Peace through strength was an acceptable maxim to throw out until you had real military actions
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:27.559
    | text      = and overthrows that you needed to spin, and it feels to me like this appealing to gunboat
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:32.059
    | text      = diplomacy is the way Alex is trying to escalate that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:36.220
    | text      = The problem is that gunboat diplomacy means a number of different things to different
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:39.879
    | text      = people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.960
    | text      = For political science types, it usually refers to a country replacing their diplomatic efforts
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.159
    | text      = with threats, so the international agreements they make aren't based on shared self-interest,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:50.480
    | text      = but rather on one party knowing that the other will kill them if they violate the agreement.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:55.120
    | text      = Or even more to the point, it involves more powerful countries using displays of their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:58.720
    | text      = superior maritime weaponry as a means of coercing less powerful countries to make those agreements
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:04.159
    | text      = in the first place.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:05.919
    | text      = Alex fully understands and opposes this practice, as he's made clear repeatedly about China's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:10.240
    | text      = actions in the South China Sea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:12.840
    | text      = He cannot actually support the principle of gunboat diplomacy without giving up any reason
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:17.879
    | text      = why he should care about the idea of China invading Taiwan.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:22.120
    | text      = From my position of having listened to a ton of the show, I don't believe that Alex supports
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:25.879
    | text      = gunboat diplomacy as a concept, but there's a larger issue.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:30.480
    | text      = On Infowars, gunboat diplomacy is not a concept that involves a state intimidating another
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:36.559
    | text      = state using a show of strength.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:39.080
    | text      = On Alex's show, the term has a specific meaning, and it is about corporate imperialism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:44.639
    | text      = Here's him explaining this to a caller from April 2004.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:09.080
    | text      = Huh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:22.759
    | text      = The way Alex is using the term gunboat diplomacy in 2026 doesn't match how he's always used
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:29.159
    | text      = it in the past.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:30.159
    | text      = In the past, the term has always meant something specific.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:33.759

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
